title: Rotated, translated graph map of a C¹ function is an injective C¹ immersion
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, q a linear isometry equivalence of ℝ^{n+ℓ}, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^ℓ, x₀ ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ an open set on which u is C¹ (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω). Let φ(x) := q(graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀. Then (a) φ is injective on all of ℝⁿ, (b) φ is C¹ on Ω, and (c) for every x ∈ Ω the Fréchet derivative fderiv ℝ φ x is an injective linear map.
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω → Function.Injective (fun x => q (graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => q (graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀) Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => q (graphPoint x (u x)) + x₀) x)
